title: Network failure testing (parts 1 and 2)
proves: Every outbound client has a deadline and fails cleanly when the network drops, hangs, resets or is slow; the API stays up and recovers when the dependency returns (TCP fault proxy in front of a real Postgres and Redis).
doesNotProve: Behaviour on a real WAN or a real provider outage; faults come from a local TCP proxy, servers are never stopped.
